capabilities: Render monthly tracker strips from daily note frontmatter via a monthly-tracker code block
Track habits with boolean completion cells or file-existence highlighting
Classify string values like mood or workout type with value-to-color maps
Show numeric activity volume as binned heatmap intensity with totals and units
Open the corresponding daily note by clicking a cell, or pin a fixed month per block
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize logged daily note data as a month-at-a-glance color-coded tracker.

relations.evidence: auto-detected from the Daily Notes / Periodic Notes plugin

summary: Renders configurable monthly heatmap tracker strips in notes, built from frontmatter properties in daily note files.
